name: dokimasia
description: Compiles a frontend's routes, actions and guards into a coverage denominator, imports a reviewed UAT workbook without losing a row, drafts a disposition set a reviewer edits rather than authors, and counts only the entries a person confirmed; a closure ratio states that nothing is unaccounted for, never that anything passed.

interface.shortDescription: Compiles a frontend's routes, actions and guards into a coverage denominator, imports a reviewed UAT workbook without losing a row, drafts a disposition set a reviewer edits rather than authors, and counts only the entries a person confirmed; a closure ratio states that nothing is unaccounted for, never that anything passed.
interface.longDescription: Dokimasia is the planned home for the question a release spreadsheet cannot answer: which of an application's routes, actions and access guards has no reviewed oracle. It compiles the inventory from a pinned commit, imports the reviewed workbook without losing a row's identity, and reconciles both so every scoped item carries exactly one disposition. Version 0.1.0 ships the contract, packaging and a self-test; it compiles no inventory, imports no workbook and reconciles nothing. Every substantive verb refuses. The completed design would report a closure ratio and a gap list for one pinned commit, and would never report an item as covered without a reviewed oracle a person wrote.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $dokimasia to inspect the current frontend coverage scaffold and state which operation must be implemented before a release can be scrutinised.
